main_text.p: confido. Brevis quidem illa est, & succincta; iis tamen classibus instructa, ad quas cætera facilè revocari poterunt argumenta omnia. Ostendimus evidenter Ecclesiam Reformatam, tam in explicatione verborum Cœnæ, quàm in reliqua Sacramenti administratione, Evangelicam sequi authoritatem, Canonémq; Scripturæ; neque subterfugere inferius Patrum consentientiam tribunal, habere sibi faventem fidei analogiam, sobriámque rationem. Ecclesiam contrà, Romanam, ne uno quidem Scripturæ textu posse probare, vel verba Institutionis esse proprie intelligenda, vel calicem laicis auferendum, vel Leitur-
[The line-final catchword "tur-" is shown here as printed.]

page.notes: The bottom of the page carries the catchword "tur-" at the right. Some words near the line ends are slightly faint; "Cœnæ" and "Patrum" were read with confidence. Possible faint marks in the lower left corner are stains and were left out.
